items.title: Detention Without Physical Examination of Tamarind and Tamarind Products (Fresh, Frozen, Dried, and/or Processed) from All Countries and/or Manufacturers Due to Filth
items.label: FDA import alert 21-07
items.detail: The U.S. FDA can detain these products from listed firms in Dominica at the border (DWPE). Alert last updated 10/27/2026.
